Original: The camera slowly pans down to reveal a storefront. The signs read "Bits & Bops".
Translated: 鏡頭緩緩下移，顯露出一家店鋪的門面。招牌上寫着“Bits & Bops”。

Original: The camera cuts to black.
Hi there! Welcome to the Bits & Bops safety video!
Translated: 嗨！歡迎觀看《啵點節奏》的安全指引影片！

Original: Before we start, I need to know a little bit about you.
Translated: 在開始之前，我想先稍微了解你一下。

Original: Do you like to be shown the ropes, or do you prefer to figure things out for yourself?
Translated: 你喜歡有人手把手教學，還是喜歡自己摸索？

Original: Let me work it out
Show me how it's done
Deal! I'll be sure to demonstrate everything ahead of time for you.
Translated: 沒問題！我會確保在開始前都先示範一遍給你看。

Original: I thought so — I know an independent go-getter when I see one!
Translated: 我就知道——我一眼就看出你是那種喜歡自己來的行動派！

Original: Anyway, now that we've gotten to know each other, let's move on with the video.
Translated: 總之，既然我們已經互相認識了，繼續看影片吧。

Original: This is no ordinary record store, so you'll need to learn a thing or two before you can browse.
Translated: 這可不是普通的唱片店，所以在你開始瀏覽之前，得先學幾招才行。

Original: First thing's first — let's check your equipment.
Translated: 首先——我們先檢查你的裝備。

Original: Let's me see. What have you got there?
Translated: 讓我瞧瞧。你手上拿的是甚麼？

Original: Let me see. What have you got there?
Translated: 讓我瞧瞧。你手上拿的是甚麼？

Original: It looks like you're using...
A game controller! That's great!
Most game controllers work well out of the box, so there's nothing to worry about.
Translated: 大多數的遊戲控制器都能直接支援，不用擔心。

Original: A mouse and keyboard! That's great!
If you like, you can use the keyboard to navigate and the mouse buttons to play the games.
Translated: 如果你喜歡，可以用鍵盤操作選單，並用滑鼠按鍵來玩遊戲。

Original: Most mice tend to be more responsive than most keyboards. It can help a lot!
Translated: 部分滑鼠的反應速度比鍵盤快。這很有幫助喔！

Original: If that sounds good to you, you can go ahead and start using the mouse right now!
Translated: 如果聽起來不錯，你現在就可以開始用滑鼠操作了！

Original: Now, the games in Bits & Bops use up to two buttons, and it looks like you have more than enough.
Translated: 好的，《啵點節奏》的遊戲最多用到兩個按鍵，看來你的按鍵綽綽有餘。

Original: What do you think? Can you handle two buttons?
Translated: 你覺得呢？搞得定兩個按鍵嗎？

Original: Only two?
One, take it or leave it
Yes, only two I'm afraid. But don't think that means it will be easy!
Translated: 是的，恐怕就只有兩個。但別以為這樣就很簡單喔！

Original: You drive a hard bargain. Okay, I'll simplify the games down to one button.
Translated: 你還真會討價還價。好吧，我會把遊戲簡化成單按鍵模式。

Original: If you change your mind, come back here or head over to the settings any time.
Translated: 如果你改變主意，隨時可以回來這裏或去設定選單調整。

Original: Anyway, that's it for input!
Translated: 總之，輸入設定就這樣了！

Original: Okay, let's move on to audio. Give me a second to start the metronome...
Translated: 好，接下來是聲音。給我一秒鐘開啟節拍器……

Original: There we go!
All you have to do is tap {Action.Primary} in time with the metronome. It's that simple!
Translated: 你只要跟着節拍器按下 {Action.Primary} 就好。就這麼簡單！

Original: If you're confident, you can tap on every beat like this.
Translated: 如果你很有把握，可以像這樣每一拍都按。

Original: Or if you need a little more time, try tapping every other beat like this.
Translated: 如果你需要多一點緩衝時間，試試像這樣每兩拍按一次。

Original: Or you could even slow it right down and tap every four beats. It's up to you!
Translated: 或者你也可以放慢速度，每四拍按一次。看你高興！

Original: Just keep going until we get a good reading.
Translated: 繼續保持，直到我們抓到準確數值。

Original:
Looks like your total delay is about {Delay}ms.
{Comment}
Translated:
看起來你的總延遲大約是{Delay}毫秒。
{Comment}

Original: That's unbelievable!
If you get a negative reading, it usually means you're tapping a little ahead of the metronome.
Translated: 如果數值是負的，通常代表你按得比節拍器稍快一點。

Original:
It also usually means your delay is quite small.
That's a good thing!
Translated:
這也通常代表你的延遲非常小。
這是好事！

Original: That's incredible!
That's fantastic!
That's great!
That's pretty good!
That's not bad!
That's okay, we can work with this.
Translated: 還行，我們可以試着接受。

Original: Oh dear! That's not ideal...
If you're using Bluetooth headphones, try using wired ones instead.
Translated: 如果你用藍牙耳機，試試改用有線耳機。

Original: You can also try configuring audio in the settings menu.
Translated: 你也可以去設定選單調整音訊設定。

Original: Or you can just see how you go!
Translated: 或者直接硬着頭皮試試看！

Original: Are you happy with this result, or would you like to redo the test?
Translated: 你滿意這個結果嗎？還是想重新測試？

Original: Let's move on
Let me try again
Okay, let me start the metronome again...
Translated: 好，那我重開一次節拍器……

Original: There we go! Ready when you are.
Since your delay is relatively large, you may enjoy the game more if you enable scheduled hits.
Translated: 因為你的延遲相對較大，如果開啟「定點播放命中音效」，遊戲體驗可能會更好。

Original: You can enable scheduled hits at any time in the settings menu, or I can do it for you right now!
Translated: 你可以隨時在設定選單開啟「定點播放命中音效」，或者我現在幫你開！

Original: This won't give you the same gameplay feel, but it will allow you to offset the delay.
Translated: 這玩起來的手感會不太一樣，但能抵銷延遲的影響。

Original: Would you like to enable scheduled hits to compensate for your delay?
Translated: 你想要開啟「定點播放命中音效」來補償延遲嗎？

Original: Yes please
No thanks
Done! Hit sounds will be scheduled to compensate for your delay.
Translated: 完成！命中音效將會自動排程以補償延遲。

Original: No problem, I'm sure you've got it under control!
Now that your equipment is working, let's move on to the game.
Translated: 既然裝備沒問題了，我們進遊戲吧。

Original: There is only one golden rule: everything happens in time with the music!
Translated: 黃金法則只有一條：萬事萬物都要合上音樂的拍子！

Original: Let's try something simple. The target appears on 1, moves on 2, and you hit it on 3.
Translated: 我們先試個簡單的。目標會在1出現、在2移動，然後你在3按下去。

Original: Don't worry, you'll be fine!
Next: A silhouette appears on the right, then Bop's head appears on the left in time with the cue. The head then moves to the right to meet the silhouette.
Translated: 下一幕：剪影會在右邊出現，接着小啵的頭會跟着提示在左邊現身。然後頭會往右移，去跟剪影重合。

Original: Oh, I almost forgot — I promised to show you how it's done!
Translated: 啊呀，差點給忘了——我答應過你會先展示一下該怎麼做！

Original: Here, let me show you.
Let's do it!
Not quite, but don't worry — this is why we have the safety video!
Translated: 不太對喔，不過也別擔心，這就是為甚麼需要安全指引影片嘛。

Original: The target appears on 1, moves on 2, and you hit it on 3.
Translated: 目標會在1出現，在2移動，然後你在3按下去。

Original: Make sure you wait until it overlaps perfectly with the shadow to push the button.
Translated: 記得要等到它跟剪影完全重合時，再按下去。

Original: You can do it!
You've got it!

Translated: 差不多快結束了，只剩最後一件事。

Translated: 因為所有動作都是跟着音樂拍子的，所以最重要的是要用聽的。

Original: If in doubt, trust your ears over your eyes.
Translated: 如果不確定，請相信你的耳朵，而不是眼睛。

Original: Let's try the same test again, but with more personality.
Translated: 我們再做一次同樣的測試，今次我玩點花樣。

Let's do it!

Original: The target appears on 1, moves on 2, and you hit it on 3.
Try not to be thrown off by the movement. Trust your ears!
Translated: 試着別被運動軌跡迷惑，相信自己的耳朵吧。

Original: You've got this!
Perfect, you're a natural!

Translated: 《啵點節奏》安全指引影片到此結束，感謝你的關注！

Original: You're now welcome to browse the store. Remember to listen to the music, and above all, have fun!
Translated: 現在歡迎你自由逛逛商店。記得要仔細聽音樂，最重要的是，玩得開心！

Translated: 等等，你剛才不是才來過嗎？

Original: Do you really want to watch the safety video again, or were you just messing around?
Translated: 你是真的想再看一次安全指引影片，還是在鬧着玩？

Original: No thanks, I'm ready to browse
You can never be too careful

Translated: 我想也是。從來沒人想再看一次安全指引影片……

Original: In fact most people don't even want to watch me the first time.
Translated: 說真的，大部份的人甚至連第一次都不想看我。

Translated: 真奇怪——身為一部安全指引影片，閱人無數，卻從來交不到朋友。

Original: Anyway, never mind that. I'll just be here while you're having fun in the store.
Translated: 總之，別提那些傷心事了。你在商店開心玩的時候，我就待在這裏。

Absolutely! That's what I always say.
Now then, on with the video...
Oh, I remember you. It's so nice of you to visit!
Translated: 噢，我記得你。你能再次光臨真是太好了！

Original: I don't get many repeat customers. What a pleasant surprise!
Translated: 我這邊很少有回頭客呢。真是個大驚喜！

Original: It's a sauce bottle.
A bottle of dark dipping sauce for grilled foods. It looks like it's been opened before.
Translated: 一瓶用來沾烤物的深色沾醬。看起來之前被打開過。

Original: It's a dragon statue.
A small dragon figure made of wood. Its surface is coated in a shiny lacquer.
Translated: 一個木製的小型龍公仔。表面塗有一層光亮的漆。

Original: It's a white cat figurine.
A ceramic cat figurine holding a hammer and a nail. It looks fragile.
Translated: 一個拿着錘子和釘子的陶瓷貓公仔。看起來很脆弱。

Original: It's a cluster of cave crystals.
A rock of unknown origin. It has pointy crystals growing from its surface.
Translated: 一塊來源不明的岩石。表面長出了尖尖的水晶。

Original: It's a saltwater aquarium.
A small marine tank, home to a school of tiny coldwater fish.
Translated: 一個小型海水缸，裏面住着一群微小的冷水魚。

Original: Its jagged rock aquascape provides lots of places for the residents to hide.
Translated: 裏頭嶙峋的岩石造景為居民們提供了許多藏身之處。

Original: It's a commemorative coin.
A large, shiny medallion with a parrot motif. It comes with a little display stand.
Translated: 一枚巨大閃亮的徽章，上面有鸚鵡圖案。附有一個小展示架。

Original: It's a coin chest.
A fancy wooden box with a coin slot on the top. It is sure to keep your loose change safe.
Translated: 一個精緻的木盒，頂部有投幣口。肯定能妥善保管你的零錢。

Original: It's a fancy tea set.
This lovely tea set is both appealing and functional. It is sure to delight guests.
Translated: 這組可愛的茶具既美觀又實用。肯定能讓客人賓至如歸。

Original: It's a moon globe.
A model of a faraway moon. Its markings look realistic, but it is unclear which moon it represents.
Translated: 一個遙遠衛星的模型。上面的紋路看起來很逼真，但不清楚這究竟是哪一顆衛星。

Original: It's a black oil lamp.
The flame from this cast iron oil lamp burns from its body rather than its spout.
Translated: 這盞鑄鐵油燈的火焰是從燈身燃燒，而不是從燈嘴。

Original: Strangely, the fire never seems to run out of fuel.
Translated: 奇怪的是，這火似乎永遠燒不完。

Oh, hi there! Welcome to Bits & Bops!
Translated: 噢，嗨！歡迎光臨《啵點節奏》！

Original: I'm Bop, and this is my shop!
Have you watched the safety video yet?
Translated: 你看過安全指引影片了嗎？

Original: Yes
No
Great, then you're free to browse!
I'm going to have to insist you watch the safety video before you browse.
Translated: 那我得堅持請你先看完安全指引影片，才能開始逛喔。

Original: Are you sure you haven't watched the safety video yet?
Translated: 你確定你還沒看過安全指引影片嗎？

Original: Yes
No
Oh, I see — just a little joke. Good one!
Translated: 噢，我懂了——只是開個小玩笑。這招不錯！

Original: In that case, you're free to browse!
Translated: 既然這樣，那就請隨意逛逛吧！

Original: Okay, come this way and I'll show you the safety video.
Translated: 好，這邊請，我帶你去看安全指引影片。

Original: The minigames are to your right, and the lounge is on your left.
Translated: 右手邊可以玩小遊戲，左手邊是休息區。

Original: We've only just opened, so our selection is a little limited. Please bear with us!
Translated: 我們才剛開，所以商品選擇還不是很多。請多多包涵！

Original: By the way, if you ever need anything, just ring the bell.
Translated: 對了，如果有任何需要，按鈴叫我就好。

Original: Okay, that's everything. Have fun!
Translated: 好，就這些了。祝你玩得開心！

Original: Wow, you cleared your first minigame. Great work!
Translated: 哇，你通關了第一盤小遊戲。做得好！

Original: By the way, a package just arrived. It's for you!
Translated: 對了，剛好有個包裹寄來了。是指名給你的！

Original: Head over to the counter to collect it, or we'll hold it while you keep browsing.
Translated: 去櫃台領吧，或是我們先幫你收着，你繼續逛也行。

Original: Remember to come back and check your mail every now and then!
Translated: 記得偶爾回來檢查一下包裹喔！

Original: Whoa, you just unlocked a mixtape!
Translated: 哇嗚，你剛解鎖了一卷混音帶！

Original: Mixtapes are special — they combine everything you've learned in previous minigames.
Translated: 混音帶很特別——它匯集了你在之前的小遊戲中學到的所有技巧。

Original: This one looks lush and vibrant, like a tropical safari!
Translated: 這一卷看起來充滿生機與活力，就像一場熱帶叢林探險！

Original: I think you're ready for it. Give it a go!
Translated: 我覺得你準備好了。去挑戰看看吧！

Original: Wow, you cleared a mixtape! Great work!
Translated: 哇，你通關了一卷混音帶！做得好！

Original: By the way, I've got some good news. We've opened a new area!
Translated: 對了，有個好消息。我們開放了一個新區域！

Original: Our game corner to your right offers a bit of a change of pace.
Translated: 右邊的遊戲區可以讓你稍微轉換一下心情。

Original: Why don't you head over and check it out while you wait for the new minigames to arrive?
Translated: 在等待新小遊戲到貨的期間，不如去那邊看看吧？

Original: Welcome to the game corner!
I should mention the games here work a bit differently.
Translated: 我得提醒一下這裏的遊戲會稍微有點不一樣。

Original: You can play these by yourself, or with up to four players!
Translated: 你可以自己玩，也可以最多四個玩家一起玩。

Original: Once you've had enough, you can quit at any time from the pause menu.
Translated: 只要玩夠了，從暫停選單退出就好。

Original: You can access the pause menu in a minigame by pressing {Action.Quit}.
Okay, that's everything!
I'll be at the counter if you need me. Have fun!
Translated: 需要我就來這邊找我。要玩開心啊！

Original: Great news — the new minigames have arrived!
Translated: 好消息——新的小遊戲到貨了！

Original: Head back to the shelves when you're ready to check them out.
Translated: 準備好嘗鮮的時候，就回到貨架那邊看看吧。

Original: Well what do we have here? It's another mixtape!
Translated: 瞧瞧這是甚麼？是另一卷混音帶！

Original: This one looks carefree and adventurous, like it could go anywhere it wants.
Translated: 這一卷看起來無拘無束、充滿冒險精神，就像想去哪就去哪！

Original: That sounds like it has you written all over it!
You cleared another mixtape! Nice!
Translated: 你又通關了一卷混音帶！太棒了！

Original: I'm sorry to say that we're waiting for the new minigames to arrive again.
Translated: 很抱歉，我們又要等待新的小遊戲進貨了。

Original: Why don't you head over to the game corner while you wait?
Translated: 等待的時候，要不要去遊戲區晃晃？

Original: Great news — the new minigames have arrived!
Head back to the shelves when you're ready to check them out.
Oh boy, it's another mixtape!
This one looks deep and mysterious, like it's hiding some secrets.
Translated: 這一卷看起來深沉又神祕，感覺裏面藏着甚麼祕密。

Original: I have a feeling it would bend the rules a little, if such a thing were allowed.
Translated: 我有種預感，如果情況允許的話，它可能會稍微遊走在規則邊緣喔。

Original: Anyway, I'm sure you can handle it!
Translated: 總之，我相信你一定搞得定！

Original: Wow, you cleared another mixtape!
Translated: 哇，你又通關了一卷混音帶！

Original: You'll never believe it, but we're waiting for the new minigames to arrive again.
Translated: 說來你可能不信，但我們又要等待新的小遊戲進貨了。

Original: Perhaps another trip to the game corner is in order?
Translated: 不如再去遊戲區逛一趟如何？

Original: Great news — the new minigames have arrived!
Head back to the shelves when you're ready to check them out.
Well if it isn't another mixtape!
Translated: 哎呀，這不是又一卷混音帶嗎！

Original: I'm a little worried about this one, it looks dangerous!
Translated: 這卷讓我有點擔心，它看起來很危險耶！

Original: Good thing you're here to take care of it for us!
Translated: 幸好有你在，可以幫我們搞定它！

Original: You cleared the last mixtape! That's amazing!
Translated: 你通關了最後一卷混音帶！太神啦！

Original: I just knew you'd be able to handle it!
Translated: 我就知道你一定搞得定！

Original: Well, that's it! You've completed absolutely everything we have to offer!
Translated: 好啦，這就是全部了！你已經完成了所有的挑戰！

Original: Unless I'm forgetting something...
Great news — the new minigames have arrived!
Wait a minute, we weren't expecting a delivery...
Translated: 等等，我們應該沒有訂新東西了啊……

Original: Oh my gosh, that was incredible!
The style! The moves! The flair!
Translated: 看那身段！那動作！那氣勢！

Original: You proved yourself in every single minigame!
Translated: 你在每個小遊戲裏都證明了自己的實力！

Original: And just in time too, since we're about to close for the day.
Translated: 而且時間點抓得剛剛好，我們今天正好要打烊了。

Original: Thank you for visiting Bits & Bops. I hope we see you again soon!
Translated: 感謝光臨《啵點節奏》，希望能很快再見到你！

Original: This one's tough, isn't it?
Don't worry, I'm sure you'll get it!
Or if you'd rather move on, I can always help you out. Just ring the bell!
Translated: 不過要是想跳過，我也可以幫你。按鈴叫我吧！

Original: That one didn't suit you, huh?
That's no problem, I can always help you out!
Translated: 沒問題，我隨時可以幫你！

Original: If you'd rather move on, just head to the counter and ring the bell!
Translated: 如果你想先跳過，直接到櫃檯按鈴囉！

Original: By the way, this mail pile is getting a little out of hand.
Translated: 對了，這堆信件已經堆得有點失控了。

Original: Please stop by the counter and check your mail soon!
Translated: 請盡快到櫃台來確認一下你的郵件！

Original: Sorry to interrupt, but this mail pile is looking rather unsafe.
Translated: 抱歉打擾了，但這堆信件看起來有點危險。

Original: Please take a moment to check your mail. Someone could get hurt!
Translated: 請花點時間確認一下郵件吧。不然有人要受傷了！

Original: I hope that helped. Now it's your turn!
Translated: 希望這對你有幫助。現在換你了！

Original: Oh, you must be the customer Bop told me about. Welcome back!
Translated: 噢，你一定就是小啵跟我說過的那位客人吧。歡迎回來！

Original: Bop's away at the moment, so I'll be looking after the counter for a while.
Translated: 小啵現在不在，暫時由我來顧櫃台。

Original: By the way, I'm Bit. I'm the one who keeps things running around here.
Translated: 順帶一提，我是小點。這裏的大小事都是我在打理的。

Original: Just so you know, we're not expecting any more minigames to arrive any time soon.
Translated: 跟你說一聲，我們短期應該不會再進新的小遊戲了。

Original: Just so you know, it might be a while before we get any more minigames.
Translated: 跟你說一聲，短期內我們不會有更多小遊戲了。

Original: Besides, we don't even have any more shelf space left!
Translated: 況且，我們的貨架也已經沒位置放了！

Original: I told Bop we didn't have room for that Final Mixtape, but he didn't listen...
Translated: 我早跟小啵說過沒地方放那卷「最終混音帶」了，但他就是不聽……

Original: Anyway, if you're looking for advice on where to go from here, just ask!
Translated: 總之，如果你想知道接下來該做甚麼，儘管問我！

Original: Now if you'll excuse me, I need to go and look at the record player.
Translated: 失陪了，我要去檢查一下那部唱機。

Original: Bop told me the speed settings are acting up again.
Translated: 小啵跟我說轉速設定又變得怪怪的。

Original:
He said it was affecting the minigames somehow,
but that doesn't make any sense...
Translated:
他說這不知為何影響到了小遊戲，
但這根本說不通……

Original: Oh, I see you've found the workshop!
Translated: 哦，看來你找到工作坊了！

Original: Here, you can use the jukebox to play levels made by other players.
Translated: 在這裏，你可以使用點唱機來遊玩其他玩家製作的關卡。

Original: Check out the selection and see what they have to offer!
Translated: 看看有哪些可選內容，瞧瞧它們都提供了些甚麼吧！

Original: You've got mail! Let's take a look...
Translated: 你有新郵件！讓我們來看看……

Original: Wow, nice! Come back to check your mail any time.
Translated: 哇，真不錯！隨時歡迎回來檢查郵件。

Original: Looks like you don't have any mail right now. Check back again soon!
Translated: 看來你現在沒有郵件。晚點再來看看吧！

Original: Hello! What can I help you with?
Translated: 哈佬！有甚麼我可以幫你的嗎？

Original: Show me the safety video
Help me with this level
Help me with this minigame
I just want to ring the bell
No problem, you can never be too careful!
Translated: 沒問題，小心駛得萬年船嘛！

Original: Of course, right this way!
Having some trouble? Don't worry, it happens to the best of us.
Translated: 遇到困難了嗎？別擔心，這種事誰都會遇到的。

Original: How would you like me to help?
Show me how it's done
Clear it for me
Never mind
No problem! One demonstration coming right up!
Translated: 沒問題！馬上為你示範一遍！

Original: Can I tell you something?
Translated: 我可以告訴你一個祕密嗎？

Original: I'm actually not very good at these endless minigames myself!
Translated: 其實我自己也不太擅長這些無盡模式的小遊戲！

Original: If you can't figure it out, come back here and I'll skip it for you.
Translated: 如果你真的搞不懂，就回來找我，我幫你直接跳過。

Original: Sure thing! Pass me the controller and I'll clear it for you.
Translated: 沒問題！把控制器給我，我來幫你通關。

Original: Sure thing! I'm quite sure I just heard the delivery a moment ago anyway.
Translated: 沒問題！反正我剛好好像聽到進貨的聲音了。

Original: Hmm, I don't want to clear it for you if you haven't tried it for yourself yet.
Translated: 嗯……如果你還沒自己試過，我不太想直接幫你通關耶。

Original: I'll make you a deal: play it once from start to finish, then I'll help if you're still stuck.
Translated: 這樣吧：你先從頭到尾試玩一次，如果還是卡關，我再來幫你。

Original: Sometimes you just have to believe in yourself!
Translated: 有時候你只需要相信自己！

Original: Hmm, I don't want to skip it for you if you haven't even looked at it yet.
Translated: 嗯……如果你連看都沒看過，我不太想幫你跳過耶。

Original: I'll make you a deal: give it your best shot, then I'll help if you're still stuck.
Translated: 這樣吧：你先盡力試試看，如果還是卡關，我再來幫你。

Original: Sometimes you just have to keep an open mind!
Translated: 有時候你得保持開放的心態！

Original: That's the spirit! Come back any time if you change your mind.
Translated: 這就對了！改變心意的話隨時回來找我。

Original: It doesn't look like there's anything for me to help you with right now.
Translated: 現在看起來沒甚麼需要我幫忙的。

Original: Okay, I'll just wait here then.
Wow, that's really annoying!
Hi again!
The minigames are to your right. Please browse at your leisure!
Translated: 小遊戲都在你的右手邊。請慢慢挑選！

Original: And if you need any help, just ring the bell!
The new minigames should be arriving any minute now.
Translated: 新的小遊戲應該隨時會送到。

Original: Please head over to our casual games area while you wait!
Translated: 等待的時候，請先去我們的休閒遊戲區逛逛吧！

Original: Please head over to the game corner while you wait!
Translated: 等待的時候，請先去我們的遊戲角逛逛吧！

Original: And if you get stuck, remember to ring the bell!
Translated: 如果過不了關，就按鈴叫我！

Original: I forgot to mention — we just set up the community computer in the lounge!
Translated: 對了，差點忘了，我們在休息室裏放了一台公用電腦！

Original: Bit wanted to put a password on it, but I said that felt too unfriendly.
Translated: 小點本來想設個密碼，不過我覺得那樣就太見外了。

Original: Besides, I think we can trust our customers!
Translated: 再說了，我相信我們的顧客。

Original: Why would they want to break something we've shared with them?
Translated: 難道他們會故意弄壞我們共享給大家的東西不成？

Original: They wouldn't, I'm sure of it!
And let's hope so, since we can't afford another one...
Translated: 希望吧……反正我們也買不起第二台了……

Original: By the way, Bit said that she's fixed the computer. Hooray!
Translated: 對了，小點說她修好電腦了。萬歲！

Original: I sure hope nobody breaks it again...
Translated: 真心希望別再有人把它弄壞了……

Original: Some mail arrived for you, and I've been dying to know what's inside!
Translated: 你有信件到了，我超想知道裏面是甚麼的！

Original: Thanks for collecting your packages, we're running pretty short on space around here.
Translated: 謝謝你來領包裹，我們這裏的空間真的不太夠用了。

Original:
You don't have any mail at the moment, but thanks
for checking.
Translated: 你目前沒有信件，不過還是謝謝你來確認。

Original: Did you really need to ring that? I'm right here.
Translated: 你真的有必要按那個嗎？我就在這裏耶。

Original: Yes, it works. There's no need to check again.
Translated: 是啦，那個鈴沒壞。不用再試了。

Original: If you keep ringing that, I'm just going to ignore you.
Translated: 如果你繼續按，我就要無視你了喔。

Original: Wow, that is extremely annoying!
You know, I'm really looking forward to knocking off early today.
Translated: 說真的，我今天好想早點下班。

Original: Everything is neat and tidy, all the shelves are stocked.
Translated: 店裏整整齊齊，貨架滿滿當當。

Original: As long as nothing happens to the community computer!
Translated: 只要那台公用電腦別出問題就好。

Original: Looking for the next big challenge, huh?
Translated: 想找下一個大挑戰是吧？

Original: Well do I have just the challenge for you!
Translated: 那我這裏正好有個適合你的挑戰！

Original: Let's see here...
It looks like you skipped a couple of minigames on your way through.
Translated: 看來你之前跳過了幾個小遊戲。

Original: In that case, that will have to be your first challenge.
Translated: 既然這樣，那這就是你的首要挑戰了。

Original: Now that you're older, stronger, and wiser, go back and beat the minigames that gave you trouble!
Translated: 現在你變得更成熟、更強大也更有智慧了，回去戰勝那些讓你頭痛的小遊戲吧！

Original: You've cleared every minigame, nice!
Translated: 你通關了所有的小遊戲，不錯喔！

Original: Well, now that you have the basics down, it's time to improve those scores!
Translated: 既然你已經掌握了基礎，是時候提高分數了！

Original: Getting a Cool sticker is a great achievement, but Amazing stickers are even better!
Translated: 拿到「夠酷」貼紙是很棒的成就，但「驚艷」貼紙更厲害喔！

Original: I think you've got it in you. Go for an Amazing sticker on every minigame!
Translated: 我覺得你有這個潛力。去把每個小遊戲都練到「驚艷」吧！

Original: And you've got an Amazing sticker on each one. Fantastic!
Translated: 你每個都拿到了「驚艷」貼紙。太精彩了！

Original: You know what that means — there's only one thing left to do.
Translated: 你知道這意味着甚麼——只剩下一件事要做了。

Original: If you can get an Amazing sticker, you're already most of the way there.
Translated: 既然能拿到「驚艷」，你離目標就只差一步了。

Original: It's time to go for a Perfect sticker on every minigame!
Translated: 是時候去挑戰每個小遊戲都拿到「完美」貼紙了！

Original: No, wait, scratch that — a Perfect sticker on each one. Incredible!
Translated: 不，等等，我話還沒說完——每個都拿到「完美」貼紙。太不可思議了！

Original: I'll bet you feel pretty accomplished right now, huh!
Translated: 我敢打賭你現在一定超有成就感，哼！

Original: I mean, what could be better than Perfect?
Translated: 畢竟，有甚麼比「完美」更好呢？

Original: In fact, there is nothing better than Perfect. Perfect is perfect!
Translated: 事實上，沒有比「完美」更好的了。「完美」就是完美！

Original: If I were you, I'd stop there and not ask again.
Translated: 如果我是你，我就會停在這裏，不再追問了。

Original: And, somehow, that's still not enough for you.
Translated: 而你，不知為何，竟然還覺得不夠。

Original: Very well, then. If you insist...
Have you ever noticed the different hit animations in the minigames?
Translated: 你有注意過小遊戲裏不同的命中動畫嗎？

Original: Sometimes you'll get an extra little flourish, and sometimes you won't.
Translated: 有時候會多一點花俏的特效，有時候則不會。

Original: Well, I'll let you in on a little secret...
Translated: 這就跟你透露一個小祕密吧……

Original: There are actually two hit windows!
If you hit only the tightest window, you can earn a whole different kind of Perfect sticker.
Translated: 如果你每次都只命中最嚴格的那個區間，就能獲得一種截然不同的「完美」貼紙。

Original: Since you've come this far, I'm sure you know what you have to do.
Translated: 既然你都走到這一步了，我相信你知道該做甚麼。

Original: Good luck!

Original: Good luck, and don't forget to take a break every now and then!
Translated: 祝你好運，還有別忘了偶爾休息一下喔！

Original: Wait a minute, they're all <ssml:sub alias="Extra Perfect"><color=#00cce3>Perfect</color></ssml:sub>? That's unbelievable!
Translated: 等等，全部都是<ssml:sub alias="超級完美"><color=#00cce3>完美</color></ssml:sub>？這太難以置信了吧！

Original: I didn't believe it could be done, but somehow, you pulled it off!
Translated: 我原本不相信有人做得到的，但不知怎麼地，你竟然辦到了！

Original: Well, I don't know what other challenge I can give you now.
Translated: 好吧，我不知道現在還能給你甚麼挑戰了。

Original: I mean, what challenge do you give to someone who has done everything?
Translated: 我是說，對於一個已經完成所有事情的人，還能給甚麼挑戰呢？

Original: You don't want to know, and I mean it this time.
Translated: 你不會想知道的，今次我是認真的。

Original: You really don't know what's good for you, do you?
Translated: 你真是自找麻煩耶，對吧？

Original: You've already got all the stickers.
Translated: 你已經拿到所有貼紙了。

Original: We have no more stickers to give you. What else do you want?
Translated: 我們已經沒有貼紙能給你了。你還想要甚麼？

Original: But since you insist, there is one more challenge, if you want it.
Translated: 但既然你堅持，如果你想要的話，確實還有最後一個挑戰。

Translated: 如果你依照順序遊玩架上每一個小遊戲，而且中間完全不休息……

Original:
Hey, have you met this guy?
His name is Mr. Farakey.
Translated:
嘿，你見過這個人嗎？
他叫法拉基先生。

Original: He's always so worried.
About what? Video games?
Surely it's not just that.

Hey, have you met this fellow?
His name is Jazz.
Translated:
嘿，你見過這傢伙嗎？
他叫爵士。

Original: He talks a lot about music.
Whenever he starts yapping, I kind of zone out...
Translated: 每次他開始滔滔不絕，我就有點放空……

Original: I hope he doesn't mind!
Hmm, I wonder if I can make these pictures move somehow.
Translated: 嗯，我在想有沒有辦法讓這些畫動起來。

Original: I hope Mr. Farakey is doing alright.
Maybe I should give him a call.
Translated: 也許我該打個電話給他。

Original: Jazz has a lot of opinions, but that's what makes him who he is.
Translated: 爵士有很多想法，但也正因如此他才是爵士啊。

Original: I like that!
Hi, I'm Runas.
I was out walking, and I wandered in here when I saw games through the window!
Translated: 我剛才在外面散步，看到窗戶裏的遊戲就走進來了！

Original: Wow, we both wandered in here at the same time! What were the odds?
Translated: 哇，我們竟然同時晃進來這裏！這機率有多低啊？

Original: You look like a fun person. What do you do when you're bored?
Translated: 你看起來是個有趣的人。你無聊的時候都做些甚麼？

Original: Play video games
Set things on fire
True!
Somehow I feel like I knew that about you. I wonder why?
Translated: 不知為何我好像早就知道你會這麼回答。為甚麼呢？

Original: Huh? No way...
Me too!
Whoa, look at the computer!
Hey, it wasn't me this time, I swear!
Translated: 嘿，今次不是我弄的，我發誓！

Original: I love video games!
Be careful out there!
I didn't do anything to the computer, I promise!
Translated: 我沒對電腦做甚麼，真的！

Original: Hellooooo~!
My name is Duvei. I'm a singer!
I came here to look for other performers.
Translated: 我來這裏是想找找有沒有其他的表演者。

Original: I know I'm small, but I looooove big crowds.
Translated: 雖然我個子小，但我超～～～愛大場面。

Original: Do you like being in the spotlight too?
Translated: 你也喜歡成為鎂光燈的焦點嗎？

Original: Yes, I love to perform!
No, it's not for me
Wooooow, a fellow performer!
You know, even when we're the centre of attention, the show's not really about us.
Translated: 你知道嗎，即使我們是眾人的焦點，但表演的主角其實不是我們。

Original: It's for the audience!
When you make them happy, it's the best feeling in the world, isn't it?
Translated: 當你讓他們開心時，那就是世界上最棒的感覺了，對吧？

Original: Awwwww, that's okay!
You can enjoy being part of the audience instead.
Translated: 你可以享受當個觀眾的樂趣。

Original: I'd be nothing without my audience!
There's a lamp with a glowing flame in it behind Bop's counter.
Translated: 小啵的櫃台後面有一盞燈，裏面有火焰在燃燒。

Original: It reminds me of the bright spotlight on a big stage.
Translated: 那讓我想起大舞台上明亮的聚光燈。

Original: Whenever I see it, I always get the urge to move closer!
Translated: 每次看到它，我就會有股衝動想靠過去！

Original: Isn't that strange?

You know how to please a crowd,
I can tell!
Translated: 你很懂得取悅群眾，我看是看得出來的！

Original: I'm so grateful people come to watch me sing.
Translated: 我很感激大家來看我唱歌。

Original:
I wonder why the flame draws
me in?
Translated: 為甚麼那火焰那麼吸引我呢？

Original: Hi, I'm Indie.
My job is to record myself playing games.
Translated: 我的工作是錄下自己玩遊戲的過程。

Original: It's a wonderful job!
I came here to look for new games to play for my fans.
Translated: 我來這裏是為了替粉絲找找有沒有新遊戲可以玩。

Original: Welcome back!
My viewers just love the games here, so I'm back for more!
Translated: 我的觀眾超愛這裏的遊戲，所以我又來找更多遊戲了！

Original: What do you like to watch other people play?
Translated: 你喜歡看別人玩甚麼樣的遊戲？

Original: Cozy games
Scary games
Good call!
It's like you and your viewers are all curled up together on a big couch with some hot cocoa.
Translated: 就像你跟觀眾一起窩在大梳化上喝熱可可一樣。

Original: Or in my case, a can of soda.
Oooh, interesting.
Scary games are only spooky until the monster jumps out.
Translated: 恐怖遊戲只有在怪物跳出來之前才恐怖。

Original: Then they're funny!
I once recorded myself playing Hammer Time and put it on the internet.
Translated: 有次我錄下自己玩「錘子時間」的影片放上網。

Original: I was sooo bad at the game, but the audience loved it.
Translated: 我玩得超～～～爛，但觀眾愛死那支影片了。

Original: I think this lounge is pretty cozy.
Translated: 我覺得這個休息室蠻舒適的。

Original: I wonder if my audience would want to see it?
Translated: 不知道我的觀眾想不想看這裏？

Original: I looked for some scary games here, but I couldn't find any!
Translated: 我在這裏找恐怖遊戲，但好像都沒找到！

Original: You don't always have to be skilled at something to entertain a crowd.
Translated: 你不一定要很厲害才能娛樂大眾。

Original: Sometimes, just being yourself is good enough!
Translated: 有時候，做你自己就夠了！

Original: Hello, I am Kafka.
Hello.
What are you?
What are you holding?
I am a shingleback lizard.
My head looks like a tail, and my tail looks like a head.
Translated: 我的頭看起來像尾巴，我的尾巴看起來像頭。

Original: Did I trick you?
Oh, this? It is a flower.
I am saving it for later, in case I get hungry.
Translated: 我把它留着，以防晚點肚子餓。

Original: Did you see the potted vine behind the counter?
Translated: 你有看到櫃台後面的盆栽藤蔓嗎？

Original: I wonder what those red flowers taste like.
Translated: 我很好奇那些紅色的花嚐起來是甚麼味道。

Original: Maybe I can grab one while Bop is not looking.
Translated: 也許我可以趁小啵不注意的時候拿一朵。

Original: My head is where all the thinking happens.
My tail? That is just for show.
Translated: 我的尾巴？那只是裝飾用的。

Original: Never leave home without a snack.
Translated: 出門絕對不能不帶點心。

Original: Do not worry, I will only take one.
I am sure Bop will not notice.
Translated: 我敢說小啵一定不會發現。

Original: Yo, I'm Ravin'! Ravin' the Raven! That's me!
Translated: 喲，我是雷文！烏鴉雷文！就是我！

Original: Yo!
Ooh yeah, I like this music! Wanna dance?
Translated: 噢耶，我喜歡這音樂！想跳舞嗎？

Original: Sure!
No thanks
Woohoo!
Respect. I'll dance on my own!
Translated: 懂，尊重。那我就自己跳囉！

Original: Aw yeah!
Gee, this music is a little slow.
Dude... it's so quiet in here!
Translated: 我說……這裏也太安靜了吧！

Original: Howdy! My name's Rory. Nice to meet ya!
Translated: 你好呀！我叫羅里。很高興認識你！

Original: Howdy! Good to see ya!
I just love this lounge. The music is so groovy.
Translated: 我超愛這個休息室。這音樂真帶感。

Original: It makes me want to tap my feet! Want to join me?
Translated: 聽得我都想跟着打拍子了！要一起嗎？

Original: Sure thing!
I'll pass
Alrighty!
No worries, I'll dance with someone else.
Dancing makes me happy, but maybe you're happier just standing still!
Translated: 跳舞讓我很開心，但也許你站着不動更開心！

Original: I just love this tune.
I'd dance, but this music is... not really my speed!
Translated: 我想跳舞，但這音樂……不太合我的拍子！

Original: Is it just me, or is it rather quiet in here today?
Translated: 是我的錯覺嗎，還是今天這裏特別安靜？

Original: Hiiii!

I'm Madam Sybil Gabriel the First.
But you can call me Sybil!
Translated:
我是西碧兒·加百列一世夫人。
不過你叫我西碧兒就好！

Original: My best friend is throwing a birthday party tonight and I need to find her a gift.
Translated: 我最好的朋友今晚要辦生日派對，我得幫她挑個禮物。

Original: Oh, oh, guess what?
Another friend is throwing a birthday party tonight and I need to find her a gift.
Translated: 另一個朋友今晚也要辦生日派對，我也得幫她挑個禮物。

Original: But I can't decide which mini-game to buy!
Translated: 但我無法決定該買哪個小遊戲！

Original: Do you have any recommendations?
Gift her Flipper Snapper
Gift her Sweet Tooth
Oooh, good thinking!
Flipper Snapper is all about making memories together, and that's what we do in real life.
Translated: 「頂球快拍」的重點就是一起創造回憶，這正是我們在現實生活中做的事。

Original: What a great idea! I just know she's going to love it!
Translated: 真是個好主意！我就知道她一定會喜歡！

Original: Oooh, good idea!
Sweet Tooth is all about sharing food together. Plus, we both love sweets!
Translated: 「嗜甜如命」的重點就是一起分享食物。而且我們都超愛甜點！

Original: What a great idea! I just know she's going to love it!
Translated: 真是個好主意！我就知道她一定會喜歡！

Original: Oh, oh, I need to tell you something.
Translated: 噢，噢，我得告訴你這件事。

Original: My best friend LOVED Flipper Snapper! It inspired her to take more photos.
Translated: 我最好的朋友超愛「頂球快拍」！這激發了她多拍照片的靈感。

Original: Now there are SO many polaroids of us on my wall.
Translated: 現在我家牆上貼了超～～多我們的即影即有合照。

Original: Thank you for the great recommendation!

My best friend LOVED Sweet Tooth!
It reinvigorated her passion for baking.
Translated: 我最好的朋友超愛「嗜甜如命」！這重燃了她對烘焙的熱情。

Original: Now we've both eaten SO many yummy cupcakes.
Translated: 現在我們兩個都吃了超～～多美味的杯子蛋糕。

Original: Thank you for the excellent recommendation!
Thanks SO much, I'm sure she'll love this!
Translated: 太感謝你了，我相信她一定會喜歡的！

Original: Oh my gosh, you are SO good at gift shopping!
Translated: 天啊，你也太會挑禮物了吧！

Original: Hey, I'm Disco.
You might not believe it, but I'm a pirate!
Translated: 你可能不信，但我可是個海盜！

Original: Right now I'm searching for treasure.
Hey! I'm still searching for treasure.
Have you seen that big shiny coin on Bop's shelf? The one with a bird engraving on it?
Translated: 你有看到小啵架子上那枚閃閃發光的大硬幣嗎？上面刻着鳥圖案的那個？

Original: I snuck behind the counter and picked it up. Turns out, it's made of plastic!
Translated: 我溜到櫃台後面把它拿起來。結果發現，那是塑膠做的！

Original: Did you see that coin chest behind the counter? I wonder what's in it.
Translated: 你有看到櫃台後面的金幣寶箱嗎？我很好奇裏面裝甚麼。

Original: I'm just waiting for Bop to get distracted so I can peek inside.
Translated: 我正在等小啵分心，這樣我就能偷看裏面了。

Original: Did you see that strange lamp in the shop? What IS that thing?
Translated: 你有看到店裏那盞奇怪的燈嗎？那是什～～嗎東西啊？

Original: I bet it's valuable, but I'm worried that if I steal it, I'll get cursed or something.
Translated: 我敢打賭那一定很值錢，但我怕如果我偷了它，會被詛咒之類的。

Original: I haven't found any loot here yet. This shop is a little empty.
Translated: 我在這裏還沒找到任何戰利品。這家店有點空。

Original: There's no point swiping a plastic coin. I'm looking for real treasure here!
Translated: 偷塑膠硬幣沒意思。我要找的是真正的寶藏！

Original: I'm not going to steal anything! I just want to see what's inside the coin chest.
Translated: 我沒有要偷東西啦！我只是想看看金幣寶箱裏面有甚麼。

Original: I really want to touch the lamp, but I don't want it to cast an evil spell on me.
Translated: 我真的很想摸摸那盞燈，但我不想被下惡毒的咒語。

Original: Let me know if you find anything valuable.
Translated: 如果你有發現任何值錢的東西，記得跟我說。

Original: Ooh, I like this funky beat.
My name is Jazz, nice to meet you.
Translated: 我叫爵士，很高興認識你。

Original: Hey, good to see you.
I'm really into music. The mixtapes here? Not bad, not bad.
Translated: 我很迷音樂。這裏的混音帶？還不賴，還不賴。

Original: Which one do you like most?
The Jungle Mixtape
The Sky Mixtape
Good taste! I love the Jungle theme.
Translated: 有品味！我喜歡叢林主題。

Original: It makes me feel like I'm on a raft, floating down a rainforest river in the warm breeze.
Translated: 那讓我覺得好像乘着木筏，在溫暖的微風中沿着雨林河流漂流。

Original: Great tune! I love the Sky theme.
Translated: 很棒的曲子！我喜歡天空主題。

Original: When I listen to it, I feel like I've been lifted into the air for a grand adventure through the clouds.
Translated: 聽的時候，我覺得好像被帶到了空中，在雲端展開一場壯麗的冒險。

Original: Say, do you know Poodley?
He's one of my best buddies.
Translated: 他是我最好的好朋友之一。

Original: He's more into art than music, though.
Translated: 不過比起音樂，他更喜歡藝術就是了。

Original: I hope I don't annoy him when I ramble about my music opinions.
Translated: 希望我滔滔不絕發表音樂高見的時候沒有煩到他。

Original:
By the way, do you know
Mr. Farakey?
Translated: 順帶一提，你認識法拉基先生嗎？

Original: He's one of my good friends.
He's amazing at video games! That's what I think about when I think of him.
Translated: 他超會打電動的！這就是我對他的印象。

Original: It's nice to chat with a fellow music appreciator.
Translated: 能跟同為音樂鑑賞家的人聊天真好。

Original: Mr. Farakey is so cool! I wish I were as good at games as he is.
Translated: 法拉基先生超酷的！真希望我也能跟他一樣會玩遊戲。

Original: Maybe I yap too much.
Translated: 也許我真的廢話太多了。

Original: What on earth are those sounds coming from the record player?!
Translated: 唱片機發出來的那是甚麼鬼聲音啊？！

Original: I was told the beats here were good, but this is a little too avant-garde for my taste.
Translated: 聽說這裏的節奏不錯，但這對我的品味來說有點太前衛了。

Original: I came here for music, but there's nothing playing! What gives?
Translated: 我是來聽音樂的，結果甚麼都沒放！搞甚麼啊？

Original: I wish I could listen to some good music right now.
Translated: 真希望能聽到一些好音樂。

Original: Ahh!
Sorry, you scared me.
Um, I'm Mr. Farakey. Good to meet you.
Translated: 嗯，我是法拉基先生。很高興認識你。

Original: Oh, hi again. Didn't see you there!
I've been trying to get a "Perfect" in every mini-game, but it's stressing me out.
Translated: 我一直試着在每個小遊戲裏拿到「完美」評價，但這讓我很焦慮。

Original: Do you like to try and get a perfect score?
Yes, I'm a perfectionist
No, I don't aim for that
Me too.
I think the stress of attempting Perfects is bad for me, but I can't help it.
Translated: 我覺得追求完美的壓力對我不利，但我就是忍不住。

Original: Ah, that's a good way to play.
I wish I could enjoy games without worrying about scoring well.
Translated: 真希望我也能享受遊戲，不用擔心分數的問題。

Original: Hey, have you met Poodley? We draw together sometimes.
Translated: 嘿，你見過小普嗎？我們有時候會一起畫畫。

Original: Drawing is much less stressful than gaming.
Translated: 畫畫比玩遊戲壓力小多了。

Original: Hey, have you met Jazz? He likes music a lot.
Translated: 嘿，你見過爵士嗎？他很喜歡音樂。

Original: I'm always worried he's judging my tastes.
Translated: 我總是很擔心他在評判我的品味。

Original: I wonder why I feel the need to get good scores in video games?
Translated: 我想知道為甚麼我會覺得非得在遊戲裏拿高分不可？

Original: Maybe there's a way to score well without worrying so much?
Translated: 也許有辦法既能拿高分又不用那麼焦慮？

Original: Maybe I should do less gaming and more drawing.
Translated: 也許我該少玩點遊戲，多畫點畫。

Original: I worry that Jazz judges me, but I hope I'm just overthinking again.
Translated: 我很擔心爵士會評判我，但希望只是我又想太多了。

Original: Hm? Oh, hello!

Excuse my inattentiveness.
I'm Professor Lotl! I study rhythm.
Translated: 請原諒我的分心。我是洛特教授！我專門研究節奏。

Original:
There's a lot of rhythm in here,
isn't there?
Translated: 這裏有很多節奏，不是嗎？

Original: Oh, hello again!
You look like a curious person. Is there something I can teach you?
Translated: 你看起來是個充滿好奇心的人。有甚麼我可以教你的嗎？

Original: Teach me about time signatures
Teach me about polyrhythms
Ah, time signatures! Those can get complicated.
Translated: 啊，拍號！那可能會變得很複雜。

Original: But at their core, they're quite simple!
Translated: 但在核心概念上，它們其實很簡單！

Original: They're usually written as two numbers, and the top one tells you how to count the beats.
Translated: 它們通常寫成兩個數字，上面的數字告訴你一小節有幾拍。

Original: If a song is in 4/4, you count to four! One, two, three, four. One, two, three, four.
Translated: 如果一首歌是4/4拍，你就數到四！一、二、三、四。一、二、三、四。

Original: But if a song is in 3/4, you only count to three! One, two, three. One, two, three.
Translated: 但如果一首歌是3/4拍，你只要數到三！一、二、三。一、二、三。

Original: With this one trick, you can count the beats in any song you come across!
Translated: 只要這招，你就能算出任何歌曲的拍子了！

Original: Ah, polyrhythms! That's quite an advanced topic.
Translated: 啊，複節奏！那是相當進階的主題。

Original: To make a polyrhythm, you need two evenly-spaced pulses at different subdivisions.
Translated: 要製造複節奏，你需要兩個在不同細分下均勻間隔的脈衝。

Original: Then when you play them at the same time, you get a polyrhythm!
Translated: 當你同時播放它們時，你就得到了複節奏！

Original: For example, in a 3:2 polyrhythm, one pulse plays three notes while the second plays only two.
Translated: 舉例來說，在3:2的複節奏中，一個脈衝會打三下，而第二個脈衝只打兩下。

Original: The second pulse plays on beat one, and between beats two and three.
Translated: 第二個脈衝會打在第一拍，以及第二拍和第三拍之間。

Original: One, two-and-three. One, two-and-three. Just like that!
Translated: 一、二又三。一、二又三。就像那樣！

Original: You can combine different subdivisions to make any crazy polyrhythm you like!
Translated: 你可以結合不同的細分來創造任何你喜歡的瘋狂複節奏！

Original: Huh? Oh, I must have dozed off again.
Translated: 蛤？噢，我肯定又打瞌睡了。

Original: Anyway, as I was saying...
Time signatures are so useful!

Polyrhythms are fascinating,
aren't they?
Say, have you played Octeaparty? That's my favourite minigame.
Translated: 話說，你有玩過「八爪茶會」嗎？那是我最喜歡的小遊戲。

Original: Why, you ask? Well firstly, I love tea. Not as much as coffee, but still.
Translated: 你問為甚麼？嗯，首先，我愛茶。雖然沒像愛咖啡那麼多，但還是很愛。

Original: Secondly, it's got an interesting time signature.
Translated: 其次，它有個很有趣的拍號。

Original: Can you guess what that is?
{TimeSignature}3/4
{TimeSignature}4/4
{TimeSignature}5/4

That's correct! 5 beats per bar!
You're a real whiz at this!
Translated:
對了！每小節有5拍！
你有點厲害呀！

Original: Ah, not quite!
Next time you play it, try counting the beats in each bar. Then you'll have your answer!
Translated: 下次玩的時候，試着數數看每小節有幾拍。這樣你就會知道答案了！

Original: You're a musical genius!
Try counting the beats in each bar to work out a song's time signature!
Translated: 試着數數看每小節有幾拍，就能推算出歌曲的拍號囉！

Original: Hey, I'm Strawbarry. A friend recommended I visit this shop, so... here I am!
Translated: 嘿，我是士多啤梨！聽朋友大力推薦這家店，所以……我就來啦！

Original: Hey. Nice of you to say hi!
Translated: 嘿，謝啦！還特意來招呼我。

Original: I heard this place opened recently.
Translated: 聽說這裏才剛開張是吧？

Original: I'm always keen to check out a new small business, even if some of the shelves are still empty!
Translated: 我這人特愛逛這種新開的小店，哪怕貨架空空的也沒事，光看着就開心。

Original: What about you?
Yes, I love being the first to try something!
No, I wait until the reviews are in
I can get behind that!
Not every new little shop, song or work of art is perfect.
Translated: 雖說新東西不一定都有趣——不管是新店、新歌還是新畫作。

Original: But the fact that someone made something for me to experience...
Translated: 但重點是有人創作出了東西，能讓我們去體驗……

Original: ...that's wonderful in and of itself!
I understand. Your time is valuable.
Translated: 懂的懂的，畢竟時間寶貴嘛。

Original: Sometimes it's better to let someone else dive in first, so they can tell you what it's like.
Translated: 確實該讓別人先去試水溫，聽聽大家怎麼說比較穩妥。

Original: And maybe that someone else is me!
Translated: 既然這樣，那小白鼠就讓我來當吧！

Original: By the way, have you played <nobr>Pop-Up Kitchen</nobr>?
Translated: 對了，你玩過那個叫<nobr>戳戳廚房</nobr>的遊戲嗎？

Original: That's my favourite minigame!
Translated: 那可是我的心頭好，最愛的小遊戲！

Original: Our chef pursues perfection. But to what end?
Translated: 我們的主廚總是那麼執着於完美，但他到底圖甚麼呢？

Original: To please her customers, of course! That's how you know she's a true artisan.
Translated: 說到底，還不就是為了讓客人開心嘛！看到這裏你就懂了，她那才是真正的匠心。

Original: If you create something for others to enjoy, you've earned my respect.
Translated: 只要你的作品能給別人帶來快樂，我就打從心底佩服你。

Original: Personally, I just love seeing what other people make.
Translated: 至於我嘛，我就是單純喜歡看大家搞創作。

Original: Why do people create for each other? I think it's because we love each other.
Translated: 人們為甚麼要為彼此創作呢？我想，大概是因為我們都在互相關心吧。

Original: The camera opens on the storefront in the evening. Light shines from the windows.
Translated: 鏡頭從傍晚時分的店鋪門面開始。窗戶裏透出燈光。

Original: The light switches off.
The camera pans up into a starry purple sky.
Translated: 鏡頭向上搖，移向繁星點點的紫色夜空。

Original: Welcome to calibration!
Here, let me start the metronome...
There we go!
All you have to do is tap {Action.Primary} in time with the metronome. It's that simple!
Translated: 你只需要按節拍按下{Action.Primary}，就這麼簡單！

Original: Just keep going until we get a good reading.
Translated: 持續按下直到我們獲得準確的讀數。

Original: Looks like your total delay is {Delay}ms.
This number should only be negative if your true delay is small and you're tapping a little early.
Translated: 只有當你的實際延遲很小且你按得稍早時，這個數值才應為負數。

Original:
If that's the case, you probably don't need to calibrate.
I'll set your offset to 0ms.
Translated:
如果是這種情況，你可能不需要校準。
我將把你的偏移量設為0毫秒。

Original: I'll apply this offset whenever you have scheduled hits enabled in the settings.
Translated: 當你在設定中啟用定點播放命中音效時，我會應用此偏移量。

Original: Since your delay is relatively small, you may enjoy the game more if you disable scheduled hits.
Translated: 由於您的延遲相對較小，停用定點播放命中音效可能會獲得更好的遊戲體驗。

Original: Since your delay is relatively large, you may enjoy the game more if you enable scheduled hits.
Translated: 由於您的延遲相對較大，啟用定點播放命中音效可能會獲得更好的遊戲體驗。

Original: By the way, it's a good idea to recalibrate any time you change your input or audio device.
Translated: 順便提醒，更換輸入設備或音訊設備時最好重新校準。

Original: Feel free to come back and recalibrate any time!
Translated: 歡迎隨時回來重新校準！
